cached_price_as_entry: not permitted; new entries still require the sealed entry quote
invalid_bid_ask: inverted, non-finite, non-positive, or wrong-instrument quotes are unavailable
m5_fallback: not used as a live management quote
missing_quote: software protection is suppressed; a time-triggered broker flatten can still close
paper_without_candles: a simulated close is not priced and is not marked successful
stale_quote: older than 90 seconds is unavailable for software stop and profit protection
